 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 45/2023 dated 13.03.2023 registered at Police Station- Khimlasa District-Sagar (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363,366-A,376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

He is in detention since 19.03.2023.
2.
As per the prosecution story, on 13.03.2023, 17 years and 10 months old prosecutrix's mother lodged F.I.R about missing of her daughter from home since the night of 10.03.2023.
prosecutrix was recovered on 17.03.2023..
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
He was having love affair with the prosecutrix.

At the time of alleged commission of offence prosecutrix was almost on the verge of completion of 18 years of age and had gone on her own with the applicant as they were interested in marrying with each other.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail.

5. Having taken into consideration prosecutrix's statement under section 164 of Cr.P.C and the fact that at the time of commission of offence prosecutrix was on the verge of completion of 18 years of age, without expressing any opinion on the merits of case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant/accused is not warranted.
Consequently, this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant- Bheema be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE MKL Bheema vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37693125/
